description:
Crystal Hearts Atelier is a Singapore-based crystal atelier offering museum-quality crystals, mineral specimens, and gemstone jewellery.

Our collections focus on carefully curated, top-grade natural crystals sourced from trusted and verified global suppliers. Each piece is selected not only for its aesthetics, but also for its structure, character, and collectability — making it suitable for collectors, interior décor, meditation, and intentional living spaces.

Our offerings include:

• Collector-grade mineral specimens
• Signature crystal décor pieces
• Rare and limited mineral finds
• Hand-selected statement crystals
• Jewellery crafted from premium natural crystals and gemstones

We ship worldwide and serve a growing community of collectors, enthusiasts, and individuals who appreciate the beauty, craftsmanship, and natural character of crystals, minerals, and gemstones.

What Makes Us Different:

Crystal Hearts Atelier operates with a collector’s mindset and curator’s eye, focusing on thoughtful selection rather than mass volume.

  • Curated, Not Bulk
    Every piece is intentionally selected. We prioritise quality, uniqueness, and visual presence — while maintaining fair pricing.
  • Collector-Level Standards
    Many of our pieces appeal to collectors at various levels who appreciate natural formations, rare inclusions, and distinctive mineral characteristics.
  • Premium Yet Grounded Philosophy
    We present crystals as tools for mindfulness or spirituality, reflection, and appreciation — without exaggerated claims or unrealistic promises.
  • Atelier-curated Releases
    We offer themed drops, archival releases, and curated selections designed to create excitement and meaningful discovery for collectors.
  • Strong Community Culture
    Our customers are not just buyers — many become long-term collectors and valued members of our community.

This makes our brand especially suitable for affiliates who value authenticity, thoughtful storytelling, and refined presentation.

How Affiliates Can Earn:

We offer a commission-based structure designed to reward consistent promotion and long-term collaboration.

Affiliates earn commissions from purchases made through their referral link or personal discount code.

Commission Structure:

• 10% standard commission on eligible sales
• Additional campaign bonuses may be offered during selected launches or special events

Commission payouts may be issued as:

• Store credit
• Cash payout (where applicable)
• Hybrid options (store credit + cash)

Billing Period & Payout Schedule

Affiliate commissions are calculated on a monthly billing cycle, running from the 1st to the last day of each calendar month.

After each billing period, commissions are subject to a 30-day validation period to allow for order fulfillment, returns, or cancellations. Approved commissions are issued on the 8th of each month in the following payout cycle.

Example:

Billing Period: January 1–31
Validation Period: February
Payout Issued: March 8

Payout Methods:

- Cash Payout

- Store Credit

- Hybrid Option (store credit + cash, for selected affiliates)

Minimum Cash Payout: $30 (balances below the minimum will roll forward to the next payout cycle)

How to Promote Us:

We encourage natural, authentic promotion that aligns with your personal voice and audience.

Affiliates may promote Crystal Hearts Atelier through a variety of channels.

Social Media Promotion

Share photos, videos, or styling ideas featuring Crystal Hearts Atelier products.

Recommended platforms:

• Instagram
• TikTok
• Pinterest
• YouTube
• Facebook

Personal Recommendations and Content Ideas

Share your genuine experiences with Crystal Hearts Atelier products. Authenticity builds trust and delivers the best results.

We encourage content created using Crystal Hearts Atelier pieces (not products from other crystal shops).

Suggested content ideas:

• Crystal styling or décor inspiration
• Unboxing videos
• Educational or informational content
• Collector showcases
• Meditation or mindful living content
• Personal storytelling

Use Your Affiliate Link or Code

Always include your referral link or your personal discount code to ensure your commissions are tracked accurately.
